---
title: "Canton flag labels"
description: "Create Datawrapper-compatible canton labels in R."
---

<div class="toolbox-kind">Snippet</div>

```r
library(stringr)

canton_with_flag <- function(canton) {
  as.character(
    str_glue(
      "![{canton}](https://interaktiv.tagesanzeiger.ch/static/kantonswappen/{canton}.svg) {canton}"
    )
  )
}

canton_with_flag("AG")
#> ![AG](https://interaktiv.tagesanzeiger.ch/static/kantonswappen/AG.svg) AG
```

This produces Markdown-style labels for Datawrapper. For canton codes, multilingual names, language, order and coordinates, keep `tamMap::canton_CH()` as the source of truth rather than duplicating a canton table here. Its current availability and fields still need verification before a larger example is added.
